newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Toyota says Australia plant near break-even.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says Australia plant near break-even.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Monday its loss-making Australian production plant would break even this year and turn a maiden profit in calendar 1998.
Toyota Australia president Sam Komori said the company's plan to put its three-year-old Melbourne factory into the black was on track.
"This year Australia's target is to reach break-even point...," Komori told a news conference in Melbourne. "We are confident so far."
Toyota's Altona factory in Melbourne was commissioned in 1994 at a capital cost of A$420 million.
The factory, which sources a lot of its components from Japan, was hit in its first 12 months by a dramatic rise in the yen against the Australian dollar, the company said.
